practicals.title: Ultrasonic Distance Lab
practicals.goal: Understand distance sensing and threshold logic.
steps: Wire VCC, GND and TRIG/ECHO pins to Arduino
Trigger high pulse on TRIG to emit ultrasonic burst
Read echo duration and calculate distance in cm
Set a threshold rule to trigger an alert LED or buzzer

practicals.title: Soil Moisture Test
practicals.goal: Learn how an analog sensor becomes a useful automated decision.
steps: Insert the soil moisture sensor probe into sample soil
Connect VCC, GND and analog output A0 to Arduino Nano
Read raw analog values and map dry vs. wet thresholds
Trigger an automatic pump or status LED based on moisture levels

practicals.title: Temperature Monitoring
practicals.goal: Convert analog sensor voltage readings into a calibrated real-world temperature display.
steps: Connect the analog temperature sensor (LM35/TMP36) to 5V and GND
Read sensor analog output on pin A0 of Arduino Mega
Convert voltage reading to Celsius using calibration formulas
Output live serial telemetry and trigger a cooling relay

projects.title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot
projects.kit: Arduino UNO + Ultrasonic Sensor + L298N Motor Driver + DC Gear Motors
projects.summary: A mobile robot chassis that continuously scans ahead, measures distance in real-time, and navigates autonomously around obstacles.
projects.learn: Ultrasonic sensing • PWM motor speed control • Directional decision algorithms • Embedded systems
projects.upgrade: Add Bluetooth/WiFi remote override and an OLED dashboard displaying distance.

projects.title: Smart Plant Watering
projects.kit: Arduino Nano + Soil Moisture Sensor + 5V Relay + Submersible Micro Pump
projects.summary: Automate plant care using real-time soil moisture feedback to trigger a water pump only when needed.
projects.learn: Analog sensor calibration • Relay switching • Power isolation • Threshold logic
projects.upgrade: Add a water reservoir level sensor and IoT mobile notifications.

projects.title: Wireless Appliance Controller
projects.kit: Arduino Mega + Multi-channel Relay Module + Wireless Transceiver
projects.summary: Build a home automation controller that safely switches AC/DC appliances with multi-point control.
projects.learn: Relay safety • Optical isolation • Microcontroller multi-tasking • State retention
projects.upgrade: Integrate ESP8266/ESP32 web server and voice control integration.
